title: Chapter 801
paragraphs: Chapter 801
Episode 198. The Transaction Underneath (1)
"Heh, that mad hunk of meat has good senses. I observed him too closely, but he recognized me right away."
Runcandel, the Garden of Swords.
Yona described the appearance of the gladiator king, Rakiman, with her gestures. The entire leadership of Runcandel, including Jin, listened to her explanation.
"In a day, no... in less than 30 minutes, they destroyed one of the main branches of Kinzelo."
The heads nodded at the words of the Tona brothers.

The land of the Beastmen is where the former headquarters of Kinzelo was located. Although the main power and most of the executives have moved to the new headquarters since the Sword Emperor's Palace, the destroyed branch was undoubtedly a very important position within Kinzelo.
Naturally, Kinzelo's superior forces were deployed there, and even at the time of the attack by the Red Names, Berakt and Badrei were on standby.
Despite this, they were completely annihilated by a single group of Red Names. Only Berakt and Badrei barely escaped.
"I thought about killing him right away, not only recognizing me but also being cheeky enough to send a message to you, but I refrained because I felt like it would be tiring."
"Eh, you could have killed that gladiator king?"
"Hehe, you don't need to be so scared to ask, Heytona. The youngest is the best, but you guys are kind of cute these days."
"Thank you, sister!"
"You don't need to thank me, it's just a little cute."
"Yes."

"Heh, I could have killed that piece of meat. The red meat seemed unwell just by looking at it. But I had a bad feeling. Even though he's weaker than me, it felt like I would get seriously hurt if I fought?"
[That must be due to the energy of the Gladiator King that Rakiman possesses, Yona.]
"Heh? The Gladiator King's energy?"

[Yes, your senses are keen, so you must have unconsciously guarded against Rakiman's special ability. The Gladiator Kings of the Red Names are not the ones who become stronger by their own ability, unlike the Gladiator Kings of the Blue Names.]
According to Ameris, the Gladiator Kings of the Red Names were beings fused with 'the fortress'.

[The ranks of the Red Names are divided into warriors, 2nd and 1st rank Gladiator Kings, Great Gladiator Kings, and War Gods. And among the 1st rank Gladiator Kings, the ones strong enough to withstand fusion are selected as Great Gladiator Kings.]
"What abilities do the Great Gladiator Kings, fused with the fortress of the Red Names, acquire?"

[It varies depending on the fortress, but summoning and fortress transformation are common to all Great Gladiator Kings. Summoning is the ability to summon the troops within the fortress, and fortress transformation is a combat transformation. It's just an animal form, despite the name fortress transformation. Perhaps the threat that Yona felt was the fortress transformation. As for summoning, he probably didn't have enough recovery yet.]
"Heh, so the meat becomes bigger meat."

"Even so, it's strange that Berakt couldn't even resist properly, even though he has such abilities. He has faced the Linpa brothers in the past and he was not so consumed by fear. He showed his pride as a warrior."

[That's probably because of the unique ability of Rakiman's fortress. From my memory, his power is about 3rd or 4th among the Great Gladiator Kings, and even the warriors of the Blue Names from his era couldn't keep their sanity when they met Rakiman. These are the people who fought well without fear, even when they met stronger Great Gladiator Kings.]
In other words, Rakiman had the ability to induce particularly greater fear in others, even among the Great Gladiator Kings.

[I remember the Red Names calling that unique ability the Beast Slaughterer... Anyway, the reason why the Beastmen Berakt and Badrei were more intimidated than before was probably because of that. The Blue Name Gladiator King level is required to completely overcome it. Berakt and Badrei could still fight because they were at a similar level.]
"It seems like a skill specialized in slaughtering the weak. Kinda like Heytona and me, right? I guess enemies weaker than us would fear us more than Jin."
[You're at it again, the 10th group. You should call him Grand Duke, not Jin. Is this a playground between brothers, or the conference room of the Garden of Swords?]
"Eh. I apologize, butler! For such a foolish mistake."
[Make sure you write an apology letter after the meeting. In the old days, it wouldn't have ended with just that.]
At the words of Leuth, a sense of tension heightened on the faces of the leadership, excluding Jin. Even the jovial Valkas was at a point where he had to cough and sneak a glance.
"Yes."

[Well, I wouldn't necessarily say that the warriors of the Blue Names are weak, but there is a similarity to what Daytona said. Originally, the Red Names themselves gave that impression in my time. Although their average power was definitely weaker than the Blue Names, everyone was more afraid. They were incredibly brutal and violent. From the Great Gladiator Kings, it couldn't be said that they were weaker than those of the same rank in the Blue Names.]
From the standpoint of Kinzelo, it was nothing short of a nightmare that Rakiman, among the Great Gladiator Kings, woke up first.

From now on, it was absolutely impossible to confront Rakiman with Beastmen alone, no matter which branch he goes to. It's not that Rakiman himself has to go there, but without Berakt and Badrei, even the ordinary warriors couldn't handle it.

[Anyway, for now, the Red Names have started hunting around Kinzelo as you expected, but I am worried. I never expected that Rakiman Hog could be active so quickly. If there are more fortresses left, he would quickly fill his quota of prey and wake up his comrades.]
After all, the Red Names won't continue to threaten Kinzelo alone.
Their greatest grudges were against Jin and Ameris. Once their power is fully restored, the Red Names would undoubtedly target the Vamel Alliance first.

"We should assume that they will awaken the other Red Names much faster than we anticipated, and act accordingly. Also, the power of the demons that Kinzelo has been hiding will begin to show," Jin said. No matter how many beastmen there were, they wouldn't be able to properly face the Red Names, so the power of the demons was bound to stand out.

"But according to Yona's story... Berakt and Badrei seemed to be worried about the strengthening power of my demons in Kinzelo. Moreover, despite the main branches being devastated, Orgal and Zephyrin are not taking any action."

"True. It's strange, as Young Patriarch said, that those two aren't acting. Rakiman even mentioned Young Patriarch's name to Berakt, so they should have come to investigate the situation immediately," Mary said. At her words, Jin smirked.
"Somehow, I have a hunch that Kinzelo will soon come to us to request a deal. Let's wait a bit while pondering what we could get from them."
Kinzelo headquarters.
When Cho came out of the treatment room, the waiting executives looked at him.
"Cho, how did it go?"
At Bishkel's question, Cho nodded.
"Badrei's arm is beyond recovery, deputy commander. However, I think we can attach the arm of a master with my and Bubar's ability."
"That's a blessing in disguise. And Berakt... Is he still in shock?"
When asked about Berakt, Cho's expression darkened.
Cho thought he would be happy if something went wrong with Berakt. After all, Berakt was the one who had constantly intimidated him for no reason and didn't treat him like a human.
However, for some reason, seeing Berakt broken and mentally unstable after being beaten by those weird guys, an unexpected sense of revenge welled up.
"Yes, he is."

"Hmph, the commander of Kinzelo, who used to be so confident, is now floundering in defeat. When the chief wakes up, I'll request him to hand over the command to the demons. It never made sense for inferior beasts to command us demons in the first place."
"Shut up, Bracken Bahama. Shagal is silent, so what makes you think you can speak out so freely?"
When Cho shouted, the demon called Bracken was taken aback.
"Hey, Cho. Weren't you the one who disliked Berakt?"
"Bracken, regardless of what anyone says, the commander of Kinzelo appointed by the chief is Berakt. He's just reflecting on a rare defeat. He'll soon rise again and annihilate them!"

"Anyway, I don't understand you humans. Anyway, I'm going to suggest to the chief. How can we fight with confidence in people like the so-called Enemy King and the great warrior who aren't worth their names?"
"Get lost."

"Well, I'm going. By the way, it would be better for you to show good to the demons, not Berakt, from now on. I don't understand why you take care of Berakt while you're always being insulted and ignored like a bug."
Cho glared at Bracken's retreating figure with his eyes wide open.
The other executives who had been watching also exchanged glances as if Cho's behavior was unexpected.
"Wow, Mr. Cho! That was cool. This Marjiel was deeply moved."
"Hmm... I just couldn't bear to see the demons ignoring us and trying to rise in status."
"I think Mr. Berakt will overcome one wall with this defeat. I can see it all in my eyes, hehe."
"Oh, does it really seem that way to Marjiel?"
The executives were aware that Marjiel's 'ability' had recently strengthened. She could see and feel things that others could not.

"Yes, it's sad that one branch has completely disappeared... but if you think it's the price of awakening for Mr. Berakt and Mr. Badrei, it's not so bad. However, I feel sorry for the dead members, so I should hold a memorial service diligently from today."
"I will also analyze the techniques of those Red Names and make our Kinzelo stronger!"
"Good, good! But before that, if we don't want to collapse, we need help!"
"...are we going to collapse?"

"Yes, from what I see, we are in a situation where we could really collapse. We need the power to hold out until the chief and the Grand Duke wake up. Of course, that's only if we lose all the beastmen... but if all the beastmen die, we won't be able to wake up Habier, right?"
"Are the demons who are currently on standby not enough?"
"It seems to be insufficient until Huanmajang and his army arrive. But we don't know when Huanmajang will come, and those Red Names could attack us again tomorrow."
Bishkel answered on behalf of Marjiel.
"Deputy Commander, what should we do?"
"We need power, as Marjiel said. A support army equipped with mobility and force to respond whenever the Red Names appear."
"Who would such a support force be... no way?"
In response to Cho's question, Bishkel sighed and answered.
"The Young Patriarch of Runcandel. We will proceed with a deal with him."
